bath-salt.name: Bath & Spa Salt

salt-tiles.name: Salt Bricks & Tiles
salt-tiles.card: Bricks, tiles and backlit panels for salt rooms, feature walls and commercial fit-outs.
salt-tiles.long: Precision-cut pink Himalayan salt bricks and tiles for salt rooms, spa walls, restaurants and retail interiors. Cut to standard or custom sizes and packed for safe transit.

lick-salt.name: Animal Lick Salt
lick-salt.card: Natural rock licks with rope and pressed blocks for livestock, horses and wildlife.
lick-salt.long: Natural pink Himalayan rock licks with a rope for hanging, plus pressed lick blocks and bulk chunks for farm, equine and animal-nutrition channels.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: For bulk edible salt our standard MOQ is one 20-ft container, but we also accept trial and mixed-container orders. Lamps, candle holders and private-label products have their own MOQs depending on packaging. Send us your requirement and we will confirm.

items.q: Can I get samples before ordering?
items.a: Yes. We send samples for quality approval. Sample and courier costs are normally adjusted against your first order.

items.q: Which shipping terms do you offer?
items.a: We ship FOB, CFR (C&F) and CIF through Karachi port, and can also quote EXW. We prepare the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and other documents your market needs.
Most orders are ready in 2–4 weeks after sample approval and advance payment, depending on quantity and packaging. Private-label orders with new printed packaging may take a little longer.

items.q: What payment terms do you accept?
items.a: Bank transfer (T/T) with an advance and the balance against shipping documents. Letters of credit (L/C at sight) can be discussed for larger orders.

items.q: Where does your salt come from?
items.a: Our salt comes from the Salt Range in Punjab, Pakistan, the same mineral belt as the historic Khewra Salt Mine and the source of genuine pink Himalayan salt.

who.p1: Rehan Salt is a pink Himalayan salt manufacturer and exporter based in the Small Industrial Estate, Jhelum, a short distance from the Salt Range and the historic Khewra Salt Mine.
who.p2: We select rock salt from the Salt Range and process it at our own unit into edible salt, lamps, cooking plates, candle holders, bath salt, bricks, tiles and animal licks. Each order is graded, inspected and packed to the buyer's specification.
who.p3: Our customers are importers, distributors, retail chains and brand owners. Whether you need a full container of bulk salt or a private-label retail line, we keep the process simple: clear specifications, fair pricing and regular updates until your goods arrive.

himalayan.title: What makes it special
himalayan.imageAlt: Striped walls inside a rock salt mine
himalayan.p1: Pink Himalayan salt is rock salt (halite) mined from the Salt Range in Punjab, Pakistan, south of the Himalayan foothills. The Khewra Salt Mine in this range is one of the oldest and largest salt mines in the world.
himalayan.p2: The salt is mostly sodium chloride. Trace minerals give it its well-known pink, red or off-white colour, which makes it popular for cooking, food presentation, decorative lamps and spa treatments.
himalayan.p3: Because the deposits formed hundreds of millions of years ago, the crystals are naturally clean and need only careful crushing, washing and grading to be ready for market.
